ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What organism does this diagram portray?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: on the left side of the image there is an adult insect, with one pair of transparent wings, six legs, short antennae, and relatively large compound eyes; its overall appearance resembles a fly of Diptera. In the upper right there is a group of small oval structures, like eggs; on the right there is an oval, segmented pupa or puparium; below there is a legless, segmented, maggot-like larva. Then reason: this kind of life cycle feature composed of eggs, maggot-like larva, pupa/puparium, and adult fly fits the typical developmental stages of a housefly. Therefore the image depicts a housefly.
